interpretation.state_model: finite-dimensional density operators or explicitly related pure-state specialization
interpretation.measurement: projective measurement/instrument with explicit probabilities and post-measurement states
interpretation.classical_state: explicit classical registers updated by measurement outcomes
interpretation.feedforward: branch semantics conditioned on classical-register values
interpretation.discard: explicit subsystem discard/partial-trace semantics when used
interpretation.reset: must be declared and proved when used
interpretation.branch_completeness: all possible declared measurement outcomes are part of the proposition

notes: Target semantic profile for arbitrary-input dynamic protocol flagships. It does not imply hardware/device semantics.
